title: Fruit Into Baskets
summary: You are visiting a farm with a single row of fruit trees arranged from left to right.
statement: You are visiting a farm with a single row of fruit trees arranged from left to right. Each tree produces a type of fruit, represented by an integer in the array fruits, where fruits[i] indicates the type of fruit produced by the i-th tree. You have two baskets, and each basket can hold only one type of fruit. You must pick exactly one fruit from every tree, starting from any tree, while moving to the right. The fruits you pick must fit into your baskets. Once you encounter a fruit type that cannot be placed in your baskets, you must stop. Given the integer array fruits, return the maximum number of fruits you can collect.
constraints: Choose a contiguous segment containing at most two fruit types.
hints: This is a longest window with at most two distinct values.
Expand right and shrink left while three types are present.
Maintain frequency counts and delete zero-count types.
After shrinking, the current window is valid and is the longest valid one ending at right.
editorial: After shrinking, the current window is valid and is the longest valid one ending at right.

tests.explanation: The whole length-three segment uses two types.
The best segment is 1,2,2 of length three.
